description:
List shipped orders from StarShipIt. Returns orders that have been manifested and dispatched to the carrier.

**When to use:** Use to check dispatch history or to feed downstream tracking workflows.

**Parameters:**
- `since_shipped_date` (optional) — Only return orders shipped after this ISO 8601 timestamp
- `limit` (optional, default 50, max 250) — Number of results per page
- `page` (optional, default 1) — Page number
- `response_format` — `"markdown"` (default) or `"json"`

**Returns:** List of shipped Order objects with tracking numbers and carrier details. Includes `has_more` flag.

**Errors:** 401 if API keys invalid.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 50, max: 250)

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for machine-readable

since_shipped_date.description: Only return orders shipped after this ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)

name: starshipit_list_shipped_orders

object.description: The response payload when StarShipIt returns a non-object value

success.description: StarShipIt success flag (a boolean on most endpoints)

title: List Shipped Orders
